title: Victron BMV Charge Recovery After Shore Power
dataSources: Battery telemetry (`marine:battery`), AIS traffic (`marine:ais`), shore power (`marina:power`), tide forecasts (`tide:table`), export syncs (`marine:export`).
app: Boating and marine telemetry — Victron BMV battery exports, AIS transponder logs, shore-power meter readings, and NOAA tide tables — streamed to Splunk HEC via NMEA exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marine:battery shore_power_cycle=* recovered_ah=*
| stats avg(recovered_ah) as avg_recovered_ah, count as events by shore_power_cycle
| sort - avg_recovered_ah
description: Shows average recovered amp-hours by shore-power cycle for battery recharge sessions.
value: Average recovered amp-hours by shore-power cycle helps compare battery recharge sessions across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `recovered_ah` on `marine:battery` events and normalize `shore_power_cycle` so Splunk can summarize performance by shore-power cycle.
visualization: Bar chart of average recovered amp-hours by shore-power cycle.
grandmaExplanation: It flags the average recovered amp-hours for each shore-power cycle so you can see what works best for battery recharge sessions.
